instruction: I prefer watching movies at a higher volume level on VLC. Can you increase the maximum volume slider limit to 300% of the original volume?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires increasing VLC's max volume to 300% (qt-max-volume=300 in vlcrc config file). Nearly identical to original task but with different target value (300% vs 200%).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement - checking qt-max-volume=300 in VLC config file
Getter (get_vlc_config) extracts the correct state - reads vlcrc configuration file where qt-max-volume is stored
Metric (check_qt_max_volume) implements correct comparison logic - parses config file and checks if qt-max-volume equals 300
Expected value (300) is semantically correct and matches the instruction requirement (300% volume)
Postconfig properly handles state management - kills and relaunches VLC to ensure config is saved and loaded
Complete coverage - evaluator checks the exact requirement stated in the instruction
Data flow is correct: config file -> getter reads -> metric compares -> returns 1 if matches 300
